recommendation: Keep the no-change audit for FHIR-12049. If Pharmacy decides an explicit step sequence number or ElementDefinition.orderMeaning is required, apply that through the active R6 ballot issues rather than reopening this DSTU2-era applied issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12049 was Published/Persuasive for Pharmacy and asked to add a sequence number to dosage instructions so same-number instructions are concurrent, different-number instructions are sequential, and ordered dosage courses can be represented without absolute start dates.
initial_application: No git commit message on the searched history names FHIR-12049 directly. A source pickaxe found commit 6a4b0d916ec0983d3c0e8a2d28366e99dc12fc76, `TR#12840 - changed DosageInstruction to Dosage`, adding `Dosage.sequence` with the requested order/concurrent/sequential wording and a note that the all-or-none sequence invariant still needed to be added.
additional_context: Current active source no longer models the issue's medication dosageInstruction elements as repeated Dosage entries. MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, and MedicationStatement now use DosageDetails; fhir.ini records `Dosage.sequence=` in the R5-to-R6 change map; FHIR-51540 and Medication Zulip discussion describe the R6 redesign that removed sequence and introduced DosageDetails/DosageSafety. Later FHIR-54329 and FHIR-54597 ask whether DosageDetails.step should get an explicit number or order semantics, but those issues remain Triaged/Unresolved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing Dosage.sequence or adding a new DosageDetails.step number under this old issue would bypass active unresolved Pharmacy WG decisions. The current dosage narrative says DosageDetails steps are sequential and same-step components are concurrent, so the original sequencing/concurrency behavior is represented in the current model.

related_jiras.note: R6 dosage redesign removed Dosage.sequence and added DosageDetails/DosageSafety; used as context but not decided because the default run is not deciding Resolved - change required issues.
